lines.say: This library has 50736 stars, and it measures text without ever touching the DOM.
Pretext is a pure JavaScript and TypeScript library for multiline text measurement and layout.
The first measures a paragraph's height with no DOM layout and no reflow.
A call to prepare does the one-time work: it normalizes whitespace, segments the text at its break opportunities and measures the segments with canvas.
After that, layout is pure arithmetic, for example at 320 pixels wide with a line height of 20.
That height unlocks proper virtualization without guesstimates and caching.
The second use case lets you lay out the paragraph lines manually yourself.
layoutWithLines gives you every line at a fixed width, and layoutNextLineRange routes text one row at a time.
The example string even mixes English, Chinese, Arabic and a rocket emoji.
Save this for the next time you build a virtualized list.
